candidates.change_summary: Change the transfer condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0.
Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 0 ether.
Change the second require to allow block.timestamp equal to pastBlockTime (>= instead of >).
Delete the update of pastBlockTime, so the timestamp check never prevents reentry in the same block.
Delete the timestamp check, allowing multiple calls in the same block.
Delete the msg.value check, allowing calls with any amount of Ether.
Move pastBlockTime update before the timestamp check, making the check almost always pass (except first call).
